development_pool.weighting: equal weight over all frozen Development pairs

interpretation_boundary.generalization: Development-only mechanism evidence from one training seed; no Public Test or broad generalization claim.
interpretation_boundary.removed_response: paired latent response produced after replacing all history frames by x_q.
interpretation_boundary.removed_target_mse_increase: removed target MSE minus correct target MSE; positive values mean history removal increased error.
interpretation_boundary.support: Auxiliary off-support-sensitive ablation; it cannot replace the on-support correct-versus-swapped G_swap evidence.

removed_history_protocol.input_support_boundary: Query-preserving temporal ablation; repeated-frame histories may be outside the native Training history distribution.
removed_history_protocol.query_frame: terminal query RGB x_q at frame index 2
